title: Oven-Baked Onion Rings
description: Making baked onion rings is easy! For crunchy and flavorful results, you just need a sliced onion, a hot oven, and a few ingredients for breading.
ingredients: 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
3 cups panko bread crumbs, or more if needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 large yellow onion - ends trimmed off, peeled, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Spray a large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.
Whisk egg whites, milk, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a large resealable plastic bag. Place panko in a separate bowl.
Add onion slices to the bag and shake until well coated in the flour mixture.

Working in batches, transfer a few onion slices to the milk mixture and toss with tongs until coated. Lift to let excess liquid drip back into the bowl, then transfer to the panko and toss until evenly coated. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining onions. Spray coated onions lightly with cooking spray.
Bake in the preheated oven until onions are tender and crumbs are light golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes.
